note: Shapes only the built-in presets may use (release lists, sourced groups, portion marks, absorption), loaded in preset mode: each must still be refused. Deployment files never reach these checks: the loader refuses the shapes first (refusals.json).

refusals.release-no-portion: names its no-release token by portion
refusals.no-release-two-owners: the no-release token "HOME ONLY" is in 2 groups
refusals.tetragraph-unknown-member: member "ZZZ" is not a known country
refusals.release-line-collision: groups tags lines and other accept the same words ("REL TO ", "REL TO AAA")
refusals.release-display-same: the release and display lines must differ, and neither may begin the other
refusals.release-display-prefix: the release and display lines must differ, and neither may begin the other
